textos.Además del certificado, pide al conectar: On top of the certificate, it asks for the 6-digit code from an app like Google Authenticator or Aegis when connecting. A stolen .ovpn is no longer enough: you also need their phone. It is only asked for on connect, not on every key renewal.

textos.Al conectar, su cliente pedirá usuario y: When connecting, their client will ask for a username and a password: the username does not matter (let them use %(cn)s) and the password is the code from the app.
textos.Al cumplirla se le desconecta y tiene qu: When it is met they are disconnected and have to connect again; if their certificate has a password, they will have to type it again. Empty or 0 = the global one (%(global)s).
textos.Alguien acaba de reducir las notificacio: Someone has just reduced this panel's notifications.
textos.Algunas sesiones empiezan antes del tram: Some sessions start before the stretch that is paired up (the %(n)s most recent events), so only their exit is recorded.
textos.Alta descartada. Borra la cuenta antigua: Setup discarded. Delete the old account from your app before starting another: the previous key no longer works.
textos.Aviso retirado. Todos los perfiles se de: Notice removed. All the profiles were downloaded.
textos.Avisos de sucesos importantes por correo: Alerts about important events, by email and by Discord. This is the only part of the panel that goes out to the internet: up to here it only talks to the machine itself. The recipients and the credentials are set in /etc/ovpn-web/config.yaml, which this panel can read but not write — so whoever compromises it cannot redirect the alerts to another mailbox.
textos.Bloqueado por el panel (%(bloqueo)s). Se: Blocked by the panel (%(bloqueo)s). It lifts on its own when the condition is no longer met.
textos.Cada <code>.ovpn</code> lleva su propia: Every .ovpn carries its own key, generated when it is downloaded. There is no shared key to rotate: if a profile leaks, revoking that client is enough.
textos.Cada administrador activa el suyo desde: Each administrator enables their own two-step verification from their profile; you cannot impose it on anyone from here. What you can decide is whether accounts with the %(rol)s role are required to use it.
textos.Cada fila empareja una conexión con su d: Each row pairs a connection with its disconnection. What is not recorded is not filled in: a session with no recorded exit is said so, instead of being given a duration nobody measured. The most recent events are paired, not the whole history: an entry and its exit can be days apart, so they have to be looked at in one stretch.
textos.Cada franja necesita al menos un día: Each time window needs at least one day
textos.Categorías que dejan de avisar: %(catego: Categories that will no longer notify: %(categorias)s
textos.Certificado de '%(cn)s' reemitido. Desca: Certificate for '%(cn)s' reissued. Download the new .ovpn: the previous one no longer works.
textos.Cifrar la clave privada con contraseña: Encrypt the private key with a password
textos.Cliente '%(cn)s' creado con la clave pri: Client '%(cn)s' created with the private key encrypted. You will be asked for the password when connecting, so give it through a channel other than the file itself.
Client '%(cn)s' created without a password. Careful: their .ovpn is direct access to the VPN for whoever gets hold of the file.
textos.Como fail2ban, con los sucesos que el pa: Like fail2ban, but using the events the panel already stores: an IP that accumulates failed attempts —packets without the tls-crypt key, handshakes that never complete, certificates from another CA— is blocked in the firewall for a while. The block is lifted by the kernel itself when it expires, even if the panel is stopped.
textos.Compresión activa en el túnel: Compression is active in the tunnel
textos.Comprimir antes de cifrar filtra informa: Compressing before encrypting leaks information about the content (VORACLE).
textos.Comprueba que los destinos responden. Ma: Checks that the destinations respond. It sends a test message through every channel that has a destination in config.yaml, whether it is enabled or not.
textos.Con 'preferred' se rechazan certificados: With 'preferred', certificates with SHA1 signatures or RSA keys under 2048 bits are rejected.
textos.Con 'verify-client-cert %(modo)s' se pue: With 'verify-client-cert %(modo)s' anyone can get in without a certificate.
textos.Con IP fija recibe siempre la misma dire: With a fixed IP they always get the same address inside the VPN.
textos.Con contraseña, OpenVPN la pide al conec: With a password, OpenVPN asks for it when connecting and the file on its own is not enough. Give it to whoever uses the profile through a channel other than the .ovpn itself. It cannot be recovered: if it is lost, the certificate has to be reissued.
textos.Con él, un .ovpn robado no basta para en: With it, a stolen .ovpn is not enough to get in: its owner's mobile device is needed too. It is only asked of the clients that have it enabled.
Password for '%(usuario)s' updated. Their sessions have been closed.
textos.Copia de <code>%(db_path)s</code> con la: A copy of %(db_path)s made with SQLite's backup API —consistent even while the panel is in use— compressed into %(dir)s. That directory is set in config.yaml, which the panel cannot write: if it could be chosen from here, anyone who got in could send whole copies of the database to a path of their own.
textos.Cualquiera en internet puede iniciar un: Anyone on the internet can start a TLS handshake with the server: this is the door to denial-of-service attacks and to OpenSSL failures before authentication.
textos.Cuando caduque, NADIE podrá conectar a l: When it expires, NOBODY will be able to connect to the VPN, and the error the client sees does not say so. It has to be renewed on the server.
textos.Cuando caduque, OpenVPN rechazará TODAS: When it expires, OpenVPN will reject ALL connections, not just those of revoked certificates, and the error does not mention the CRL.
textos.Cuando caduque, ese cliente no podrá con: When it expires, that client will not be able to connect. It is renewed by reissuing its certificate: revoke and restore it from the panel, and hand them the new .ovpn.
textos.Cuenta blindada: al superusuario solo lo: Locked account: only the superuser can administer this account.

textos.Para todos los clientes que no tengan un: For every client that does not have one of their own in their policies. When it is met they are disconnected and have to connect again. Empty or 0 = no limit.
textos.Pasa las contraseñas de los clientes a l: It passes client passwords to the scripts through environment variables. The panel only needs level 2.
textos.Protege el canal de control de la VPN y: It protects the VPN control channel and is embedded in every .ovpn. Rotating it is what to do if a whole profile leaks: it invalidates every profile handed out at once.
textos.Puedes cambiarla desde <a href=\"/admin/: You can change it from Panel accounts, or on the server with python -m app.cli cambiar-password %(usuario)s.
textos.Pídele el cambio a un administrador del: Ask a panel administrator to change it for you.
textos.Que %(cn)s la escanee con su app, o que: Have %(cn)s scan it with their app, or type it in:
textos.Quedan <strong>%(pendientes)s</strong> d: %(pendientes)s of %(total)s still to download. The mark only says you downloaded the file, not that it reached its destination.
textos.Quien llegue a ese puerto puede expulsar: Anyone who reaches that port can disconnect clients and see who is connected, without a password.
textos.Quien se haga con un .ovpn tiene la clav: Whoever gets hold of a .ovpn has everyone's key. With tls-crypt-v2 every profile carries its own; it needs OpenVPN 2.6 on the server and on the clients.
textos.Quita '%(directiva)s' cuando todos los c: Remove '%(directiva)s' once every client is 2.5 or later
textos.Quitada. Su perfil actual sigue pidiendo: Removed. Their current profile still asks for a username and a password: download them a new one, or have them leave the password empty.
textos.Quién más tráfico lleva este mes: Who has used the most traffic this month
textos.Quítalo si los clientes no necesitan ver: Remove it if clients do not need to see each other
textos.Respaldo automático desactivado. No se h: Automatic backup disabled. No new copy will be made until you schedule it again.
textos.Revisión del <code>%(ruta)s</code> contr: Review of %(ruta)s against OpenVPN's hardening recommendations. Read only: the panel cannot write the server.conf —whoever could would run code as root— so every fix comes with the line that has to be put in by hand. Afterwards, restart OpenVPN.
textos.Revoca o restaura cualquier cliente desd: Revoke or restore any client from the panel to regenerate it
textos.Se arregla revocando o restaurando cualq: It is fixed by revoking or restoring any client from the panel: that regenerates the CRL. Or on the server:
textos.Se descartará el alta en curso y tendrás: The setup in progress will be discarded and you will have to start again. The key saved in the app will stop working. Continue?
textos.Se generará una clave nueva y la de su a: A new key will be generated and the one in their app will stop working. Continue?
textos.Se hace copia de la anterior, se comprue: A copy of the old one is made, the format of the new one is checked before replacing it, and if OpenVPN does not come back up the old one is restored by itself. No client will be able to connect until it gets a new profile: the list will appear in VPN clients when it finishes.
textos.Se hizo una operación que invalida los p: An operation was carried out that invalidates the profiles.
They are asked for the code when connecting.
textos.Se puede exigir un código de la app del: A code from the mobile app can be required of every client from its policies.
textos.Se reemitirá el certificado de %(cn)s. E: The certificate for %(cn)s will be reissued. The previous .ovpn will stop working. Continue?
textos.Se renueva regenerándola: revoca o resta: It is renewed by regenerating it: revoke or restore any client from the panel, or on the server:
textos.Se te pide un código cada vez que entras: You are asked for a code every time you sign in.
textos.Se usan los de serie de esta versión. De: The defaults of this version are used. Declaring them makes clear what gets negotiated and avoids surprises on upgrade.
textos.Segundo factor activado. A partir de aho: Two-step verification enabled. From now on you will be asked for a code when signing in.
textos.Segundo factor de '%(usuario)s' restable: Two-step verification for '%(usuario)s' reset and their sessions closed. They will have to set it up again.
textos.Segundo factor exigido a las cuentas de: Two-step verification required for accounts with the %(rol)s role. Those without it will only be able to go to their profile until they enable it.
textos.Según la biblioteca TLS, podría aceptars: Depending on the TLS library, TLS 1.0 or 1.1 could still be accepted.
textos.Sesiones caducadas, logins a medias y co: Expired sessions, half-finished sign-ins and attempt counters
textos.Si el mismo perfil conecta dos veces, Op: If the same profile connects twice, OpenVPN closes the previous session, and the panel logs it as a displaced session.
textos.Si lo estás leyendo, este canal funciona: If you are reading this, this channel works.
textos.Si no has sido tú, este es el último avi: If this was not you, this is the last notice you will receive through this channel.
textos.Si prefieres no escanear, introduce la c: If you prefer not to scan, enter the key by hand:
textos.Siguen revocados y en la CRL, así que su: They stay revoked and in the CRL, so their .ovpn files do not work. They are not removed from the PKI on purpose: the CRL is regenerated from index.txt every time someone is revoked, and taking a certificate out of there would give it back its validity in that next regeneration. They can be deleted for good when the CA is rebuilt, once they are signed by an authority that no longer exists and there is nothing left to block.
textos.Sin 'user', un fallo en el proceso que a: Without 'user', a failure in the process that serves the clients is a failure with root privileges.

textos.Sin ella no se pueden cruzar los fallos: Without it, the known security issues cannot be cross-checked.
No lines to show with that filter.
textos.Sin permisos para leer %(ruta)s. El usua: No permission to read %(ruta)s. The service user must belong to the 'adm' group.
textos.Sin root, OpenVPN no puede volver a leer: Without root, OpenVPN cannot read the keys again or open the tunnel when it restarts in place.
textos.Sin él, un certificado de servidor de la: Without it, a server certificate from the same CA could pose as a client.
textos.Solo lectura. Para cambiarla edita <code: Read only. To change it, edit /etc/ovpn-web/config.yaml and restart ovpn-web.
textos.Solo lo necesitan clientes 2.3/2.4, que: Only 2.3/2.4 clients need it, and they do not negotiate. Without such clients, removing it leaves the data channel in authenticated-only mode (GCM).
textos.Solo se permiten letras, números, punto,: Only letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore are allowed, starting and ending with a letter or a digit
textos.Solo se te pide la contraseña para entra: You are only asked for your password to sign in.
textos.Subida más bajada. Al agotarla se le des: Upload plus download. When it runs out they are disconnected and cannot get back in until the 1st of the following month, when it is lifted automatically. Empty = no quota.
textos.Sucesos del log de OpenVPN, del más reci: Events from the OpenVPN log, newest first. The panel reads them every few minutes and stores them in its database, so the history no longer depends on the file, which logrotate empties every week. How long they are kept is up to you, deleting them from Settings.
textos.Tienes un alta a medias. Escribe el códi: You have a half-finished setup. Enter the code from your app to finish it.
textos.Todavía no se ha anotado ningún respaldo: No automatic backup has been recorded yet.
textos.Token CSRF no válido. Recarga la página: Invalid CSRF token. Reload the page and try again.

Your superuser role cannot be changed.
textos.Tu rol es <strong>supervisor</strong>: p: Your role is supervisor: you can check the status, but not create, revoke or disconnect.
textos.Tu rol no permite esta acción: Your role does not allow this action
textos.Un .ovpn copiado puede conectarse en par: A copied .ovpn can connect in parallel to the legitimate one without anyone noticing, and the panel can no longer detect shared profiles.
textos.Un administrador ha impuesto el segundo: An administrator has imposed the second factor on accounts with your role, so you cannot disable it.
An administrator has imposed the two-step verification on accounts with your role. Enable it to use the panel.
An administrator has imposed the two-step verification on your role: you cannot disable it.
textos.Un certificado revocado deja de entrar e: A revoked certificate stops getting in on the next connection.
textos.Un código de 6 dígitos que cambia cada 3: A 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds, generated by an app on your phone. If someone steals your password, it is not enough on its own.
textos.Un perfil filtrado no compromete a los d: A leaked profile does not compromise the others.
textos.Una franja no puede empezar a las 24:00: A time window cannot start at 24:00
textos.Uno por línea: <code>192.168.1.0/24</cod: One per line: 192.168.1.0/24, 192.168.1.10 or 192.168.1.10:443/tcp. If you set any, only those will be reachable, the server itself included. Empty = no limit. It requires a fixed IP.

textos.tls-crypt: canal de control cifrado y au: tls-crypt: control channel encrypted and authenticated

textos.¿Desactivar la verificación en dos pasos: Disable the two-step verification on your account?
